newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian rupee ends unchanged at 35.65/66 per dlr.
newsitem.headline: Indian rupee ends unchanged at 35.65/66 per dlr.

text.p: The Indian rupee ended Thursday at 35.65/66 per dollar unchanged from opening quotes, dealers said.

"There was virtually no movement in the exchange rate today," said a dealer at a state-run bank. The Reserve Bank of India bought dollars in small quantities between 35.6625 and 35.6650 rupees, he said.

Premia on forward dollars ended the day firmer after opening low, dealers said. "There was some receiving pressure in the morning which pushed premia down," said a dealer. "But by close, rates were almost back to yesterday's closing levels."
The premia on six-month dollars ended Thursday at an annualised 8.42 percent against Wednesday's close of 8.36.
